observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor courtyard or garden with brick walls, paved walkway and grassy area, daytime
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, appearing to be adults
observation.formation_and_space: group dances in a loose line or facing pairs, moving back and forth on the walkway and grass
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: bouncing steps on the beat, stamping and stepping side to side
observation.arms_and_hands: arms extend to the sides or wave with hands open, sometimes clapping or holding small white cloths
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso twists and slight hip sways coordinated with steps
observation.partnering: independent dancing in a group formation, occasional paired facing moments without close contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level with occasional small jumps and pivots, no floor work
observation.costume_and_props: men wear red long coats over blue shirts, sashes, trousers, and straw hats; women wear long pink and purple dresses with white sashes and straw hats
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot weight distribution and micro-rhythms due to low video resolution and camera cuts

signature_moments.what: dancers line up and extend arms outward while stepping in place with a bounce
women wave small white cloths overhead while stepping and turning slightly
dancers drop briefly to one knee on the grass
dancers bow slightly while sweeping arms down and out
